conclusions: For these fixed eight roots and this host state, encoding layout dominates baseline old/new native MSE disagreement; public single-vs-bank rollout layout contributes smaller nonzero differences.

Feedback/public outputs are identical for both models under all executed settings. LeWM reduction is unchanged; DINO scalar-vs-row-batched float32 reduction differs slightly while captured tensors and common float64 metrics are unchanged.

Changing only the convolution fp32 precision permission from tf32 to ieee sharply reduces measured old/new disagreement for both models, while also shifting individual same-layout outputs and encoded targets relative to baseline. This is a causal sensitivity result for this control on this sample, not kernel-level localization or evidence of improved physical accuracy.
